_comment: Model registry for /solnest-clone-ad. Every model runs through KIE.ai's one unified API (jobs/createTask), so adding a model = one entry here, no code change. Client-portable: one KIE key unlocks all of these. NOTE the per-model variance the registry absorbs: 'refs_key' is the input field a model expects reference images under (Nano Banana uses image_input, Flux uses input_urls, Seedream takes none); 'size_mode' is whether the model takes aspect_ratio (most) or image_size (Seedream enum). Slugs verified against docs.kie.ai 2026-06.
_default_model_note: Ryan's call after the I1 live test: GPT Image 2 won by a wide margin (best text, cleanest composition). A normal run uses ONLY this model x3. default_set below is opt-in comparison mode.

nano-banana-pro.note: Google Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3). Best text rendering + face/character consistency, up to 4K. The default for face- or text-heavy ads.

nano-banana.note: Google Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash). Cheap + fast text-to-image. Good volume option.

seedream.note: ByteDance Seedream. BROKEN as of 2026-06: slug 'bytedance/seedream' returns state=FAIL on KIE — slug likely rotated (try a Seedream 4.5/5 slug). Not in default_set until verified. Pure prompt (no refs).

flux-pro.note: Black Forest Flux 2 Pro. Photoreal, strong lighting. Needs >=1 reference image (image-to-image).

gpt-image-2.note: ChatGPT Image 2 (text-to-image). Best on-image text rendering + polished composition. Blank-canvas; use gpt-image-2-edit to condition on a reference.

gpt-image-2-edit.note: ChatGPT Image 2 image-to-image. Needs >=1 reference image. Best for faithful pixel-level clone (keep frame, swap text).
